name: Wald's consistency theorem, real criterion
scope_note: A real-valued criterion, continuous in the parameter and dominated in absolute value, so it does not reach likelihoods with parameter-dependent support. The extended-real form is wald-extended.

name: Wald's consistency theorem, extended-real criterion
statement:
ExtremeValueTheory.ae_tendsto_of_wald_ereal.{u_1, u_2, u_3} {Θ : Type u_1} [MetricSpace Θ]
  [CompactSpace Θ] {α : Type u_2} {mα : MeasurableSpace α} {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure α}
  {m : Θ → α → EReal} {G : α → ℝ} [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure μ] {Ω : Type u_3}
  {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {P : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} {X : ℕ → Ω → α}
  (hX : ∀ (i : ℕ), ProbabilityTheory.HasLaw (X i) μ P) (hind : ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun X P)
  (husc : ∀ (x : α), UpperSemicontinuous fun θ => m θ x) (hmeas : ∀ (θ : Θ), Measurable (m θ))
  (hsup : ∀ (θ : Θ) (r : ℝ), Measurable fun x => ⨆ θ' ∈ Metric.ball θ r, m θ' x)
  (hG : MeasureTheory.Integrable G μ) (hbound : ∀ (θ : Θ) (x : α), m θ x ≤ ↑(G x)) {θ₀ : Θ}
  (h₀ : ∀ᵐ (x : α) ∂μ, m θ₀ x ≠ ⊥) (hint₀ : MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun x => (m θ₀ x).toReal) μ)
  (hident :
    ∀ (θ : Θ),
      θ ≠ θ₀ →
        (∀ᵐ (x : α) ∂μ, m θ x ≠ ⊥) →
          MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun x => (m θ x).toReal) μ →
            ∫ (x : α), (m θ x).toReal ∂μ < ∫ (x : α), (m θ₀ x).toReal ∂μ) :
  ∀ᵐ (ω : Ω) ∂P,
    ∀ (θhat : ℕ → Θ) (ε : ℕ → ℝ),
      Filter.Tendsto ε Filter.atTop (nhds 0) →
        (∀ᶠ (n : ℕ) in Filter.atTop,
            ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, m θ₀ (X i ω) ≤
              ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, m (θhat n) (X i ω) + ↑(↑n * ε n)) →
          Filter.Tendsto θhat Filter.atTop (nhds θ₀)
scope_note: Compact parameter space, upper semicontinuous criterion, measurability of local suprema as a hypothesis, one integrable upper envelope. Compactifying a non-compact parameter space is not covered.

name: Strong consistency of the joint GPD MLE
statement:
ExtremeValueTheory.ae_tendsto_gpdMLE'.{u_1} {K : Set (ℝ × ℝ)} {Ω : Type u_1}
  {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {P : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} {X : ℕ → Ω → ℝ} (hK : IsCompact K)
  (hKS : ∀ p ∈ K, -1 < p.1 ∧ 0 < p.2) {θ₀ : ℝ × ℝ} (hθ₀ : θ₀ ∈ K)
  (hX : ∀ (i : ℕ), ProbabilityTheory.HasLaw (X i) (ExtremeValueTheory.gpdMeasure θ₀.1 θ₀.2) P)
  (hind : ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun X P) :
  ∀ᵐ (ω : Ω) ∂P,
    ∀ (θhat : ℕ → ℝ × ℝ) (ε : ℕ → ℝ),
      (∀ (n : ℕ), θhat n ∈ K) →
        Filter.Tendsto ε Filter.atTop (nhds 0) →
          (∀ᶠ (n : ℕ) in Filter.atTop,
              (ExtremeValueTheory.gpdLogLikE θ₀.1 θ₀.2 fun i => X (↑i) ω) ≤
                (ExtremeValueTheory.gpdLogLikE (θhat n).1 (θhat n).2 fun i => X (↑i) ω) +
                  ↑(↑n * ε n)) →
            Filter.Tendsto θhat Filter.atTop (nhds θ₀)
scope_note: Maximizers over a compact parameter set K in {xi > -1, sigma > 0}, chosen in advance. The estimator is not the maximizer over the whole parameter space.

name: Strong consistency of the GPD scale MLE, known shape
statement:
ExtremeValueTheory.ae_tendsto_gpdScaleMLE.{u_1} {ξ σ₀ : ℝ} {Ω : Type u_1} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω}
  {P : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} {X : ℕ → Ω → ℝ} (hξ1 : -1 < ξ) (hξ : ξ ≠ 0) (hσ₀ : 0 < σ₀)
  (hX : ∀ (i : ℕ), ProbabilityTheory.HasLaw (X i) (ExtremeValueTheory.gpdMeasure ξ σ₀) P)
  (hind : ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun X P) :
  ∀ᵐ (ω : Ω) ∂P,
    ∀ (s : ℕ → ℝ),
      (∀ᶠ (n : ℕ) in Filter.atTop,
          (s n ∈ ExtremeValueTheory.gpdScaleDomain ξ fun i => X (↑i) ω) ∧
            ((1 + ξ) * ExtremeValueTheory.gpdScaleScore ξ (s n) fun i => X (↑i) ω) = ↑n) →
        Filter.Tendsto s Filter.atTop (nhds σ₀)
scope_note: The shape is known, and xi != 0. One parameter out of two.

name: Asymptotic normality of the exponential MLE
scope_note: The case xi = 0 with the shape known. Stated for the sample mean, which is the MLE.

name: Asymptotic normality of the GPD scale MLE, known shape
statement:
ExtremeValueTheory.tendstoInDistribution_gpdScaleMLE'.{u_1, u_2} {ξ σ₀ : ℝ} {Ω : Type u_1}
  {Ω' : Type u_2} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {mΩ' : MeasurableSpace Ω'} {P : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω}
  {P' : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω'} {X : ℕ → Ω → ℝ} [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure P]
  [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure P'] (hξ : -1 / 2 < ξ) (hξ0 : ξ ≠ 0) (hσ₀ : 0 < σ₀)
  (hX : ∀ (i : ℕ), ProbabilityTheory.HasLaw (X i) (ExtremeValueTheory.gpdMeasure ξ σ₀) P)
  (hind : ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun X P) {Z : Ω' → ℝ}
  (hZ :
    ProbabilityTheory.HasLaw Z (ProbabilityTheory.gaussianReal 0 (σ₀ ^ 2 * (1 + 2 * ξ)).toNNReal)
      P') :
  MeasureTheory.TendstoInDistribution
    (fun n ω => √↑n * ((ExtremeValueTheory.gpdScaleMLE ξ fun i => X (↑i) ω) - σ₀)) Filter.atTop Z
    (fun x => P) P'
scope_note: The shape is known, -1/2 < xi, xi != 0.

name: Joint asymptotic normality of a GPD MLE
statement:
ExtremeValueTheory.exists_gpdMLE_tendstoInDistribution.{u_1, u_2} {ξ₀ σ₀ : ℝ} {Ω : Type u_1}
  {Ω' : Type u_2} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {mΩ' : MeasurableSpace Ω'} {P : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω}
  [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure P] {P' : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω'}
  [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure P'] {X : ℕ → Ω → ℝ} {K : Set (ℝ × ℝ)} (hK : IsCompact K)
  (hKS : ∀ p ∈ K, -1 < p.1 ∧ 0 < p.2) (hθ₀ : (ξ₀, σ₀) ∈ interior K) (hξ₀ : -1 / 2 < ξ₀)
  (hξ₀0 : ξ₀ ≠ 0) (hσ₀ : 0 < σ₀)
  (hX : ∀ (i : ℕ), ProbabilityTheory.HasLaw (X i) (ExtremeValueTheory.gpdMeasure ξ₀ σ₀) P)
  (hind : ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun X P) {W : Ω' → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)}
  (hW :
    ProbabilityTheory.HasLaw W
      (ProbabilityTheory.multivariateGaussian 0 (ExtremeValueTheory.gpdFisherInfoInv ξ₀ σ₀)) P') :
  ∃ g,
    (∀ (n : ℕ), Measurable (g n)) ∧
      (∀ (n : ℕ) (x : Fin n → ℝ),
          g n x ∈ K ∧ IsMaxOn (fun p => ExtremeValueTheory.gpdLogLikE p.1 p.2 x) K (g n x)) ∧
        MeasureTheory.TendstoInDistribution
          (fun n ω => √↑n • !₂[(g n fun i => X (↑i) ω).1 - ξ₀, (g n fun i => X (↑i) ω).2 - σ₀])
          Filter.atTop W (fun x => P) P'
scope_note: A compact parameter set K with the truth in its interior, xi0 > -1/2, xi0 != 0. The case xi0 = 0 is not done. The statement gives one measurable maximizer with this limit (existential); the form for every measurable maximizer is tendstoInDistribution_gpdMLE_all.

name: Strong consistency of the GEV MLE
statement:
ExtremeValueTheory.ae_tendsto_gevMLE.{u_1} {K : Set (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ)} {Ω : Type u_1}
  {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {P : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} {X : ℕ → Ω → ℝ} (hK : IsCompact K)
  (hKS : ∀ p ∈ K, -1 < p.1 ∧ 0 < p.2.2) {θ₀ : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ} (hθ₀ : θ₀ ∈ K) (hσ₀ : 0 < θ₀.2.2)
  (hX :
    ∀ (i : ℕ),
      ProbabilityTheory.HasLaw (X i) (ExtremeValueTheory.gevLocScaleCDF θ₀.1 θ₀.2.1 hσ₀).measure P)
  (hind : ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun X P) :
  ∀ᵐ (ω : Ω) ∂P,
    ∀ (θhat : ℕ → ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) (ε : ℕ → ℝ),
      (∀ (n : ℕ), θhat n ∈ K) →
        Filter.Tendsto ε Filter.atTop (nhds 0) →
          (∀ᶠ (n : ℕ) in Filter.atTop,
              (ExtremeValueTheory.gevLogLikE θ₀.1 θ₀.2.1 θ₀.2.2 fun i => X (↑i) ω) ≤
                (ExtremeValueTheory.gevLogLikE (θhat n).1 (θhat n).2.1 (θhat n).2.2 fun i =>
                    X (↑i) ω) +
                  ↑(↑n * ε n)) →
            Filter.Tendsto θhat Filter.atTop (nhds θ₀)
scope_note: Approximate maximizers over a compact parameter set K in {xi > -1, sigma > 0}, chosen in advance. The GEV maximizer over the whole parameter space is not covered.

name: Identifiability of the three-parameter GEV family
statement:
ExtremeValueTheory.gev_params_eq_of_measure_eq {ξ μ σ ξ' μ' σ' : ℝ} (hσ : 0 < σ) (hσ' : 0 < σ')
  (h :
    (ExtremeValueTheory.gevLocScaleCDF ξ μ hσ).measure =
      (ExtremeValueTheory.gevLocScaleCDF ξ' μ' hσ').measure) :
  ξ = ξ' ∧ μ = μ' ∧ σ = σ'
scope_note: Nothing left out.

name: The GEV Fisher information is positive definite
statement:
ExtremeValueTheory.posDef_gevFisherInfo {ξ σ : ℝ} (hσ : 0 < σ) (hξ0 : ξ ≠ 0) (hξ : -1 / 2 < ξ) :
  (ExtremeValueTheory.gevFisherInfo ξ σ).PosDef
scope_note: xi > -1/2, xi != 0: the three-parameter matrix at xi = 0 is excluded.

name: Trivariate CLT for the GEV score
statement:
ExtremeValueTheory.tendstoInDistribution_gevScoreVec3.{u_1, u_2} {ξ μ σ : ℝ} {Ω : Type u_1}
  {Ω' : Type u_2} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {mΩ' : MeasurableSpace Ω'} {P : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω}
  [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure P] {P' : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω'}
  [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure P'] {X : ℕ → Ω → ℝ} (hξ : -1 / 2 < ξ) (hξ0 : ξ ≠ 0)
  (hσ : 0 < σ)
  (hX :
    ∀ (i : ℕ), ProbabilityTheory.HasLaw (X i) (ExtremeValueTheory.gevLocScaleCDF ξ μ hσ).measure P)
  (hind : ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun X P) {Z : Ω' → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)}
  (hZ :
    ProbabilityTheory.HasLaw Z
      (ProbabilityTheory.multivariateGaussian 0 (ExtremeValueTheory.gevFisherInfo ξ σ)) P') :
  MeasureTheory.TendstoInDistribution
    (fun n ω => (√↑n)⁻¹ • ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, ExtremeValueTheory.gevScoreVec3 ξ μ σ (X i ω))
    Filter.atTop Z (fun x => P) P'
scope_note: xi > -1/2, xi != 0. It is the CLT for the score at the true parameter. Asymptotic normality of the MLE is the separate entry gev-mle-joint-normality.

name: The information identity for the GEV family
statement:
ExtremeValueTheory.integral_gevHess_eq_neg_gevFisherInfo {ξ μ σ : ℝ} (hσ : 0 < σ) (hξ0 : ξ ≠ 0)
  (hξ : -1 / 2 < ξ) (i j : Fin 3) :
  ∫ (x : ℝ),
      ExtremeValueTheory.gevHess ξ μ σ x i j ∂(ExtremeValueTheory.gevLocScaleCDF ξ μ hσ).measure =
    -ExtremeValueTheory.gevFisherInfo ξ σ i j

statement:
ExtremeValueTheory.posDef_gumbelFisherInfo {σ : ℝ} (hσ : 0 < σ) :
  (ExtremeValueTheory.gumbelFisherInfo σ).PosDef

name: Asymptotic normality of the GEV return level
statement:
ExtremeValueTheory.tendstoInDistribution_gevReturnLevel.{u_1, u_2, u_3} {Ω : Type u_1}
  {Ω' : Type u_2} {Ω'' : Type u_3} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {mΩ' : MeasurableSpace Ω'}
  {mΩ'' : MeasurableSpace Ω''} {P : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure P]
  {P' : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω'} [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure P']
  {P'' : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω''} [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure P''] {ξ₀ μ₀ σ₀ m : ℝ}
  (hξ₀ : ξ₀ ≠ 0) (hm : 1 < m) {θh : ℕ → Ω → ℝ × ℝ × ℝ} (hθm : ∀ (n : ℕ), AEMeasurable (θh n) P)
  {V : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ} (hV : V.PosSemidef) {Z : Ω' → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)}
  (h :
    MeasureTheory.TendstoInDistribution
      (fun n ω => √↑n • !₂[(θh n ω).1 - ξ₀, (θh n ω).2.1 - μ₀, (θh n ω).2.2 - σ₀]) Filter.atTop Z
      (fun x => P) P')
  (hZ : ProbabilityTheory.HasLaw Z (ProbabilityTheory.multivariateGaussian 0 V) P') {W : Ω'' → ℝ}
  (hW :
    ProbabilityTheory.HasLaw W
      (ProbabilityTheory.gaussianReal 0
        ((ExtremeValueTheory.gevReturnLevelGrad ξ₀ σ₀ m).ofLp ⬝ᵥ
            V.mulVec (ExtremeValueTheory.gevReturnLevelGrad ξ₀ σ₀ m).ofLp).toNNReal)
      P'') :
  MeasureTheory.TendstoInDistribution
    (fun n ω =>
      √↑n *
        (ExtremeValueTheory.gevReturnLevel (θh n ω).1 (θh n ω).2.1 (θh n ω).2.2 m -
          ExtremeValueTheory.gevReturnLevel ξ₀ μ₀ σ₀ m))
    Filter.atTop W (fun x => P) P''
scope_note: Asymptotic normality of the parameter estimators is a hypothesis, so this is the delta method. For the maximum likelihood estimator, where normality is proved, see gev-mle-return-level-normality. Also xi0 != 0.

name: Confidence interval for the GEV return level
statement:
ExtremeValueTheory.tendsto_measure_mem_gevReturnLevelInterval.{u_1, u_2} {Ω : Type u_1}
  {Ω' : Type u_2} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {mΩ' : MeasurableSpace Ω'} {P : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω}
  [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure P] {P' : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω'}
  [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure P'] {ξ₀ μ₀ σ₀ m : ℝ} (hξ₀ : ξ₀ ≠ 0) (hm : 1 < m)
  {θh : ℕ → Ω → ℝ × ℝ × ℝ} (hθm : ∀ (n : ℕ), AEMeasurable (θh n) P) {V : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ}
  (hV : V.PosSemidef) {Z : Ω' → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)}
  (h :
    MeasureTheory.TendstoInDistribution
      (fun n ω => √↑n • !₂[(θh n ω).1 - ξ₀, (θh n ω).2.1 - μ₀, (θh n ω).2.2 - σ₀]) Filter.atTop Z
      (fun x => P) P')
  (hZ : ProbabilityTheory.HasLaw Z (ProbabilityTheory.multivariateGaussian 0 V) P') {s : ℝ}
  (hs : 0 < s)
  (hsV :
    s ^ 2 =
      (ExtremeValueTheory.gevReturnLevelGrad ξ₀ σ₀ m).ofLp ⬝ᵥ
        V.mulVec (ExtremeValueTheory.gevReturnLevelGrad ξ₀ σ₀ m).ofLp)
  {S : ℕ → Ω → ℝ} (hS : MeasureTheory.TendstoInMeasure P S Filter.atTop fun x => s)
  (hSm : ∀ (n : ℕ), AEMeasurable (S n) P) (z : ℝ) :
  Filter.Tendsto
    (fun n =>
      P
        {ω |
          ExtremeValueTheory.gevReturnLevel ξ₀ μ₀ σ₀ m ∈
            Set.Icc
              (ExtremeValueTheory.gevReturnLevel (θh n ω).1 (θh n ω).2.1 (θh n ω).2.2 m -
                z * S n ω / √↑n)
              (ExtremeValueTheory.gevReturnLevel (θh n ω).1 (θh n ω).2.1 (θh n ω).2.2 m +
                z * S n ω / √↑n)})
    Filter.atTop (nhds ((ProbabilityTheory.gaussianReal 0 1) (Set.Icc (-z) z)))
scope_note: Parameter normality and consistency of the standard error are both hypotheses; a Slutsky step from gev-return-level-normality. Also xi0 != 0.

name: Asymptotic normality of the POT return level
statement:
ExtremeValueTheory.tendstoInDistribution_gpdReturnLevel.{u_1, u_3} {Ω : Type u_1} {Ω'' : Type u_3}
  {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {mΩ'' : MeasurableSpace Ω''} {P : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω}
  [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure P] {P'' : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω''}
  [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure P''] {ξ₀ σ₀ u ζ N : ℝ} {X : ℕ → Ω → ℝ} {K : Set (ℝ × ℝ)}
  (hK : IsCompact K) (hKS : ∀ p ∈ K, -1 < p.1 ∧ 0 < p.2) (hθ₀ : (ξ₀, σ₀) ∈ interior K)
  (hξ₀ : -1 / 2 < ξ₀) (hξ₀0 : ξ₀ ≠ 0) (hσ₀ : 0 < σ₀)
  (hX : ∀ (i : ℕ), ProbabilityTheory.HasLaw (X i) (ExtremeValueTheory.gpdMeasure ξ₀ σ₀) P)
  (hind : ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun X P) {θh : ℕ → Ω → ℝ × ℝ}
  (hθm : ∀ (n : ℕ), AEMeasurable (θh n) P) (hθK : ∀ (n : ℕ) (ω : Ω), θh n ω ∈ K)
  (hmax :
    ∀ (n : ℕ) (ω : Ω),
      IsMaxOn (fun p => ExtremeValueTheory.gpdLogLikE p.1 p.2 fun i => X (↑i) ω) K (θh n ω))
  (hNζ : 0 < N * ζ) {W : Ω'' → ℝ}
  (hW :
    ProbabilityTheory.HasLaw W
      (ProbabilityTheory.gaussianReal 0 (ExtremeValueTheory.gpdReturnLevelVar ξ₀ σ₀ ζ N).toNNReal)
      P'') :
  MeasureTheory.TendstoInDistribution
    (fun n ω =>
      √↑n *
        (ExtremeValueTheory.gpdReturnLevel u (θh n ω).1 (θh n ω).2 ζ N -
          ExtremeValueTheory.gpdReturnLevel u ξ₀ σ₀ ζ N))
    Filter.atTop W (fun x => P) P''
scope_note: The excesses are exactly iid GPD with exceedance probability zeta known: the random number of exceedances and the approximation of real excesses by the GPD are not modelled. Compact K, xi0 > -1/2, xi0 != 0. Parameter normality is proved here, unlike the GEV case.

name: Confidence interval for the POT return level
statement:
ExtremeValueTheory.tendsto_measure_mem_gpdReturnLevelInterval.{u_1} {Ω : Type u_1}
  {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {P : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure P]
  {ξ₀ σ₀ u ζ N : ℝ} {X : ℕ → Ω → ℝ} {K : Set (ℝ × ℝ)} (hK : IsCompact K)
  (hKS : ∀ p ∈ K, -1 < p.1 ∧ 0 < p.2) (hθ₀ : (ξ₀, σ₀) ∈ interior K) (hξ₀ : -1 / 2 < ξ₀)
  (hξ₀0 : ξ₀ ≠ 0) (hσ₀ : 0 < σ₀)
  (hX : ∀ (i : ℕ), ProbabilityTheory.HasLaw (X i) (ExtremeValueTheory.gpdMeasure ξ₀ σ₀) P)
  (hind : ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun X P) {θh : ℕ → Ω → ℝ × ℝ}
  (hθm : ∀ (n : ℕ), AEMeasurable (θh n) P) (hθK : ∀ (n : ℕ) (ω : Ω), θh n ω ∈ K)
  (hmax :
    ∀ (n : ℕ) (ω : Ω),
      IsMaxOn (fun p => ExtremeValueTheory.gpdLogLikE p.1 p.2 fun i => X (↑i) ω) K (θh n ω))
  (hNζ : 1 < N * ζ) (z : ℝ) :
  Filter.Tendsto
    (fun n =>
      P
        {ω |
          ExtremeValueTheory.gpdReturnLevel u ξ₀ σ₀ ζ N ∈
            Set.Icc
              (ExtremeValueTheory.gpdReturnLevel u (θh n ω).1 (θh n ω).2 ζ N -
                z * √(ExtremeValueTheory.gpdReturnLevelVar (θh n ω).1 (θh n ω).2 ζ N) / √↑n)
              (ExtremeValueTheory.gpdReturnLevel u (θh n ω).1 (θh n ω).2 ζ N +
                z * √(ExtremeValueTheory.gpdReturnLevelVar (θh n ω).1 (θh n ω).2 ζ N) / √↑n)})
    Filter.atTop (nhds ((ProbabilityTheory.gaussianReal 0 1) (Set.Icc (-z) z)))
scope_note: Same setting as gpd-return-level-normality: exact GPD excesses, known zeta, compact K, xi0 != 0. Wald intervals; profile likelihood intervals are gpd-profile-return-level.

name: Wilks' theorem for the GPD
statement:
ExtremeValueTheory.tendstoInDistribution_gpdDeviance.{u_1, u_2} {Ω : Type u_1} {Ω' : Type u_2}
  {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {mΩ' : MeasurableSpace Ω'} {P : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω}
  [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure P] {P' : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω'}
  [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure P'] {X : ℕ → Ω → ℝ} {ξ₀ σ₀ : ℝ} {K : Set (ℝ × ℝ)}
  (hK : IsCompact K) (hKS : ∀ p ∈ K, -1 < p.1 ∧ 0 < p.2) (hθ₀ : (ξ₀, σ₀) ∈ interior K)
  (hξ₀ : 0 < ξ₀) (hσ₀ : 0 < σ₀)
  (hX : ∀ (i : ℕ), ProbabilityTheory.HasLaw (X i) (ExtremeValueTheory.gpdMeasure ξ₀ σ₀) P)
  (hind : ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun X P) {θh : ℕ → Ω → ℝ × ℝ}
  (hθm : ∀ (n : ℕ), AEMeasurable (θh n) P) (hθK : ∀ (n : ℕ) (ω : Ω), θh n ω ∈ K)
  (hmax :
    ∀ (n : ℕ) (ω : Ω),
      IsMaxOn (fun p => ExtremeValueTheory.gpdLogLikE p.1 p.2 fun i => X (↑i) ω) K (θh n ω))
  {Z : Ω' → ℝ} (hZ : ProbabilityTheory.HasLaw Z (ProbabilityTheory.chiSquared 2) P') :
  MeasureTheory.TendstoInDistribution
    (fun n ω =>
      2 *
        (ExtremeValueTheory.gpdLogLikN (θh n ω).1 (θh n ω).2 (fun i => X i ω) n -
          ExtremeValueTheory.gpdLogLikN ξ₀ σ₀ (fun i => X i ω) n))
    Filter.atTop Z (fun x => P) P'
scope_note: GPD with ξ₀ > 0 only, narrower than the regular range ξ₀ > -1/2; exact iid sample; maximizers over a compact set with the truth in its interior.

name: Profile-likelihood interval for a GPD return level
statement:
ExtremeValueTheory.tendsto_measure_mem_gpdReturnLevelProfileInterval.{u_1} {Ω : Type u_1}
  {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {P : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure P]
  {X : ℕ → Ω → ℝ} {ξ₀ σ₀ : ℝ} {K : Set (ℝ × ℝ)} (hK : IsCompact K)
  (hKS : ∀ p ∈ K, -1 < p.1 ∧ 0 < p.2) (hθ₀ : (ξ₀, σ₀) ∈ interior K) (hξ₀ : 0 < ξ₀) (hσ₀ : 0 < σ₀)
  (hX : ∀ (i : ℕ), ProbabilityTheory.HasLaw (X i) (ExtremeValueTheory.gpdMeasure ξ₀ σ₀) P)
  (hind : ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun X P) {u ζ N : ℝ} (hNζ : 1 < N * ζ) (c : ℝ) :
  Filter.Tendsto
    (fun n =>
      P
        {ω |
          ExtremeValueTheory.gpdReturnLevel u ξ₀ σ₀ ζ N ∈
            ExtremeValueTheory.gpdProfileInterval K
              (fun p => ExtremeValueTheory.gpdReturnLevel u p.1 p.2 ζ N) c fun i => X (↑i) ω})
    Filter.atTop (nhds ((ProbabilityTheory.chiSquared 1) (Set.Iic c)))
scope_note: GPD with ξ₀ > 0 only; exact iid sample; compact parameter set; u and ζ known constants. The set requires a finite maximized likelihood and is empty otherwise. Proved to be a confidence set, not that it is an interval.

name: Joint asymptotic normality of the GEV maximum likelihood estimator
source: Smith (1985); Prescott–Walden (1980); Bücher–Segers (2017) (no theorem numbers checked)
statement:
ExtremeValueTheory.tendstoInDistribution_gevMLE.{u_1, u_2} {ξ₀ μ₀ σ₀ : ℝ} {Ω : Type u_1}
  {Ω' : Type u_2} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {mΩ' : MeasurableSpace Ω'} {P : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω}
  [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure P] {P' : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω'}
  [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure P'] {X : ℕ → Ω → ℝ} {K : Set (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ)} (hK : IsCompact K)
  (hKS : ∀ p ∈ K, -1 < p.1 ∧ 0 < p.2.2) (hθ₀ : (ξ₀, μ₀, σ₀) ∈ interior K) (hξ₀ : -1 / 2 < ξ₀)
  (hξ₀0 : ξ₀ ≠ 0) (hσ₀ : 0 < σ₀)
  (hX :
    ∀ (i : ℕ),
      ProbabilityTheory.HasLaw (X i) (ExtremeValueTheory.gevLocScaleCDF ξ₀ μ₀ hσ₀).measure P)
  (hind : ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun X P) {θh : ℕ → Ω → ℝ × ℝ × ℝ}
  (hθm : ∀ (n : ℕ), AEMeasurable (θh n) P) (hθK : ∀ (n : ℕ) (ω : Ω), θh n ω ∈ K)
  (hmax :
    ∀ (n : ℕ) (ω : Ω),
      IsMaxOn (fun p => ExtremeValueTheory.gevLogLikE p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2 fun i => X (↑i) ω) K (θh n ω))
  {W : Ω' → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)}
  (hW :
    ProbabilityTheory.HasLaw W
      (ProbabilityTheory.multivariateGaussian 0 (ExtremeValueTheory.gevMLECov ξ₀ σ₀)) P') :
  MeasureTheory.TendstoInDistribution
    (fun n ω => √↑n • !₂[(θh n ω).1 - ξ₀, (θh n ω).2.1 - μ₀, (θh n ω).2.2 - σ₀]) Filter.atTop W
    (fun x => P) P'
scope_note: ξ₀ > -1/2 and ξ₀ ≠ 0; exact iid GEV sample; maximizers over a compact set with the truth in its interior. ξ₀ = 0 is not covered, and block maxima from a law in a domain of attraction are not covered.

name: Unconditional asymptotic normality of the GEV return level
statement:
ExtremeValueTheory.tendstoInDistribution_gevMLEReturnLevel.{u_1, u_2} {ξ₀ μ₀ σ₀ m : ℝ}
  {Ω : Type u_1} {Ω'' : Type u_2} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {mΩ'' : MeasurableSpace Ω''}
  {P : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure P]
  {P'' : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω''} [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure P''] {X : ℕ → Ω → ℝ}
  {K : Set (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ)} (hK : IsCompact K) (hKS : ∀ p ∈ K, -1 < p.1 ∧ 0 < p.2.2)
  (hθ₀ : (ξ₀, μ₀, σ₀) ∈ interior K) (hξ₀ : -1 / 2 < ξ₀) (hξ₀0 : ξ₀ ≠ 0) (hσ₀ : 0 < σ₀) (hm : 1 < m)
  (hX :
    ∀ (i : ℕ),
      ProbabilityTheory.HasLaw (X i) (ExtremeValueTheory.gevLocScaleCDF ξ₀ μ₀ hσ₀).measure P)
  (hind : ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun X P) {θh : ℕ → Ω → ℝ × ℝ × ℝ}
  (hθm : ∀ (n : ℕ), AEMeasurable (θh n) P) (hθK : ∀ (n : ℕ) (ω : Ω), θh n ω ∈ K)
  (hmax :
    ∀ (n : ℕ) (ω : Ω),
      IsMaxOn (fun p => ExtremeValueTheory.gevLogLikE p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2 fun i => X (↑i) ω) K (θh n ω))
  {W : Ω'' → ℝ}
  (hW :
    ProbabilityTheory.HasLaw W
      (ProbabilityTheory.gaussianReal 0 (ExtremeValueTheory.gevReturnLevelVar ξ₀ σ₀ m).toNNReal)
      P'') :
  MeasureTheory.TendstoInDistribution
    (fun n ω =>
      √↑n *
        (ExtremeValueTheory.gevReturnLevel (θh n ω).1 (θh n ω).2.1 (θh n ω).2.2 m -
          ExtremeValueTheory.gevReturnLevel ξ₀ μ₀ σ₀ m))
    Filter.atTop W (fun x => P) P''
scope_note: Same scope as the GEV likelihood theorem, with 1 < m fixed. No normality is assumed. Coverage of the Wald interval (tendsto_measure_mem_gevMLEReturnLevelInterval) still assumes consistency of the standard error.
